description: List the workspace's Insights reports, most recently edited first: id, title, description, widget count and updatedAt. Returns one page (`limit`, default 50, maximum 100); follow `meta.nextCursor` while `meta.hasMore` is true. Each report carries `url`, its Console page; when you show a report to the user, render its title as a link to that url.
name: anyforge_list_reports
title: List reports
